Compute

Development history: every build and check job run on Tláloc, the private research cluster of desktop workstations used during development, with wall-clock time, exit status and memory in use. Reproducing the formalisation needs none of this: scripts/check.sh runs on a single ordinary machine (about 12 minutes on the development workstation).
